body:
IGN: C4ncer

Discord: C4ncer#7618

Timezone: EST

Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph): I would like to join the referee team because I feel that I would be able to work well in that position. Also, I would like to join because I want to see this server grow exponentially and increase in the player count. Yeah this is about it lol

Best Time of the Week?: I'm usually free for the entire day of Saturday and like 5 - 7 pm est on weekdays because of school. However, on Sundays I'm free from 2:30 - 7 pm est due to religious activities.

A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself (Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us): Well, to begin, my name is David and I am 15 years old. I was born in Canada and I enjoy playing soccer, swimming, rugby, and tennis. I am very motivated to do tasks that are set for me such as play minecraft for too long. My main languages are English, a little bit of French (I can type it but my accent is trash) and Mandarin. I cannot sell myself because my parents are still my guardians, but I'll let you borrow me for an hour for $10 ;). I'm not sure what else to type besides that I can drink water without difficulty and I have never done drugs and I am actually straight despite my IGN....

Anything else?: Congrats on Mod Input :3


BTW THIS IS A REAL APP xD
